title: pyrus × brevipes
intro: Pyrus × brevipes, commonly known as the Chinese pear, is a hybrid species of pear tree that is widely cultivated for its edible fruit and medicinal properties. The Chinese pear is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The plant's therapeutic actions include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus × brevipes include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional Chinese medicine.
